record.name: Department of Basic Education 2026 Rainbow workbooks
record.bestFor: Parents, teachers and South African school learners
record.freeDetails: The official workbook directory links the 2026 workbooks for terms 1–2 and 3–4.
record.requirements: Choose the correct grade, subject, language and term from the official directory. Digital downloads need internet access; printing has normal paper/printing costs.
record.watchOut: No free delivery of printed books is promised. Use official DBE links; check that the selected file is the 2026 edition.

record.name: Siyavula free Mathematics and Physical Sciences practice
record.freeDetails: Siyavula advertises free online Mathematics and Physical Sciences practice.
record.requirements: Register a free learner account to use the practice tools; parents can register to track work. Internet access is required.
record.watchOut: Official July 2026 help specifies zero-rated access on MTN and Cell C; leaving Siyavula can incur data charges. Some networks need a small balance to begin access. Do not promise zero-rating on all networks.

record.name: Vodacom free school eLearning content
record.freeDetails: The platform labels school content from grades R–12 as FREE; Vodacom states content and data on the service are free for its customers.
record.requirements: Register/sign in and select the free school-grade sections. A compatible device and internet connection are needed.
record.watchOut: The platform also advertises premium learning subscriptions. This listing covers only the sections labelled FREE; external links and other networks can incur data costs. Do not sign up to premium content assuming it is free.

record.name: HP LIFE free business and digital courses
record.freeDetails: HP LIFE advertises free business/digital-skills courses in eight languages and free course-completion certificates.
record.requirements: Join HP LIFE for free and select a course from the official catalogue. Device and internet/data costs remain your responsibility.
record.watchOut: A completion certificate is not a university qualification, professional licence or guaranteed job. Check each course language and content before starting.
